title: VelocityCommand
description: The answer of the visual servoing service: a linear velocity (m/s) and an angular velocity (rad/s), when it was issued (milliseconds since the epoch), how long it is valid and its sequence number. A consumer acts on it only while it is valid and stops when it does not get a newer valid command within valid_for_ms. hold says the service asks for no movement. The schema is closed.

vx.description: Linear velocity along x, in meters per second.

vy.description: Linear velocity along y, in meters per second.

vz.description: Linear velocity along z, in meters per second.

wroll.description: Angular velocity about x, in radians per second.

wpitch.description: Angular velocity about y, in radians per second.

wyaw.description: Angular velocity about z, in radians per second.

hold.description: True when the service asks for no movement.

issued_at_ms.description: When the command was issued, in milliseconds since the epoch.

valid_for_ms.description: How long the command is valid after it was issued, in milliseconds.

seq.description: Grows with every command; a consumer ignores an older one.

frame_id.description: The frame the command was computed from, when there is one.
